query:
INSERT INTO brandMemberships (userId, brand, tier, status, source, grantedAt)
SELECT id, 'iheartecho', 'premium', 'active', 
  CASE WHEN premiumSource IS NOT NULL AND premiumSource != 'NULL' THEN premiumSource ELSE 'admin' END,
  COALESCE(premiumGrantedAt, NOW())
FROM users 
WHERE isPremium = true 
  OR id IN (SELECT userId FROM userRoles WHERE role = 'premium_user')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tier = 'premium', status = 'active';
